limitations: Disposable Linux Chromium with native audio nodes and time-domain analysers. Not physical Android/iOS, audible listening, sound-pressure measurement, screen lock, OS audio focus, service-worker upgrade, or hearing-safety acceptance.

The byte-exact existing fixture controls device speech, blocks external traffic and service workers. Initial playback and buttons use trusted Playwright clicks; ranges use keyboard input and native selects use Playwright selectOption (generated input/change events). Deterministic DSP, pause/journey and short timer edge cases explicitly use public production APIs and FR state.

Live DSP tests deliberately reject only background HTMLMediaElement admission with a labelled NotAllowedError so native live AudioParams stay audible and measurable. A final separate test restores unmodified media admission, accepts the real offline-rendered loop and tests timer ownership transfer. This is not an all-unmodified-runtime end-to-end audio claim.

Channel-preserving analyser taps do not connect new sound paths to the destination. Left/right RMS and sample peaks are measured independently, avoiding artificial binaural-beat interference from a stereo downmix. Sample peaks are not inter-sample true peaks or a guarantee of acoustic safety. Complex-mix measurements cover the documented synthetic configuration, not every possible mix.
